sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.MovieID) FROM characters c WHERE c.ActorID = (SELECT ActorID FROM actor ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(NetWorth,'$',''),',','') AS REAL) DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT T1."Height (Inches)", T1."NetWorth" FROM actor AS T1 JOIN characters AS T2 ON T1.ActorID = T2.ActorID JOIN movie AS T3 ON T2.MovieID = T3.MovieID WHERE T3.Title = 'Three Men and a Little Lady'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration r JOIN course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id WHERE c.name = 'Machine Learning Theory' AND r.grade = 'B' AND s.gpa > 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movie WHERE "MPAA Rating" = 'PG' AND "Release Date" BETWEEN '1990-06-01' AND '1990-06-30'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT ra.prof_id FROM RA JOIN prof ON prof.prof_id = ra.prof_id WHERE prof.gender = 'Male' GROUP BY ra.prof_id HAVING COUNT(ra.student_id) > 3);

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name
FROM prof p
WHERE p.prof_id IN (SELECT prof_id FROM RA GROUP BY prof_id HAVING COUNT(student_id) > 2)
  AND p.teachingability = (SELECT MAX(teachingability) FROM prof
                           WHERE prof_id IN (SELECT prof_id FROM RA GROUP BY prof_id HAVING COUNT(student_id) > 2))

SELECT c.name FROM course c JOIN registration r ON c.course_id = r.course_id WHERE c.name IN ('Advanced Operating System','Intro to BlockChain') AND r.grade = 'A' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(T1.gpa), T1.f_name, T1.l_name FROM student AS T1 INNER JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T2.capability = 5 AND T2.salary = 'high' GROUP BY T1.student_id

SELECT m.Genre FROM movie m JOIN characters c ON c.MovieID = m.MovieID JOIN actor a ON a.ActorID = c.ActorID WHERE m."MPAA Rating" = 'PG' ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(a.NetWorth,'$',''),',','') AS REAL) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN a.NetWorth > '$400,000,000.00' THEN a.ActorID END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.ActorID) AS percentage FROM characters c JOIN movie m ON m.MovieID = c.MovieID JOIN actor a ON a.ActorID = c.ActorID WHERE m.Genre = 'Drama';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration WHERE student_id = (SELECT student_id FROM student ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) FROM student s JOIN registration r ON s.student_id = r.student_id WHERE s.gpa BETWEEN 3 AND 4 AND (r.grade IS NULL OR r.grade = '')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student s WHERE s.type = 'UG' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM registration r WHERE r.student_id = s.student_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM registration r WHERE r.student_id = s.student_id AND (r.grade IS NULL OR r.grade <> 'A'))

SELECT T1.f_name, T1.l_name FROM student T1 JOIN registration T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id JOIN course T3 ON T2.course_id = T3.course_id WHERE T3.name = 'Advanced Database Systems' AND T2.sat = (SELECT MAX(TS1.sat) FROM registration TS1 JOIN course TS2 ON TS1.course_id = TS2.course_id WHERE TS2.name = 'Advanced Database Systems')

SELECT CAST(SUM(c.credit * CASE r.grade WHEN 'A' THEN 4 WHEN 'B' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'D' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / SUM(c.credit) AS gpa
FROM registration r JOIN course c ON c.course_id = r.course_id
JOIN student s ON s.student_id = r.student_id
WHERE s.f_name = 'Laughton' AND s.l_name = 'Antonio';

SELECT s.f_name, s.l_name, s.email, s.intelligence FROM student s JOIN RA ra ON s.student_id = ra.student_id WHERE ra.capability = (SELECT MAX(capability) FROM RA) AND ra.salary = 'high' ORDER BY s.student_id

SELECT s.email
FROM student s
JOIN registration r ON s.student_id = r.student_id
JOIN course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id
WHERE r.grade = 'B'
  AND c.diff > (SELECT AVG(diff) * 0.8 FROM course);
SELECT name FROM course WHERE credit = (SELECT MAX(credit) FROM course) AND diff = (SELECT MAX(diff) FROM course)

SELECT
 (SELECT AVG(s.gpa) FROM registration r JOIN course c ON c.course_id = r.course_id JOIN student s ON s.student_id = r.student_id WHERE c.diff = (SELECT MAX(diff) FROM course))
 -
 (SELECT AVG(s.gpa) FROM registration r JOIN course c ON c.course_id = r.course_id JOIN student s ON s.student_id = r.student_id WHERE c.diff = (SELECT MIN(diff) FROM course)) AS diff_avg_gpa

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, p.popularity FROM prof p JOIN RA ra ON p.prof_id = ra.prof_id GROUP BY p.prof_id HAVING COUNT(ra.student_id) = (SELECT MAX(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(student_id) AS c FROM RA GROUP BY prof_id))

SELECT c.name, s.f_name, s.l_name
FROM course c
JOIN registration r ON c.course_id = r.course_id
JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE r.grade = 'A'
  AND c.course_id = (
    SELECT r2.course_id FROM registration r2
    WHERE r2.grade = 'A'
    GROUP BY r2.course_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(r2.student_id) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY s.student_id;

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN r.salary='high' THEN g.sat END) - AVG(CASE WHEN r.salary='free' THEN g.sat END) AS avg_satisfaction_diff FROM registration g JOIN RA r ON r.student_id = g.student_id WHERE r.salary IN ('high','free');
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN sat = (SELECT MAX(sat) FROM registration WHERE course_id = 3) THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(student_id) * 1.0 AS percentage FROM registration WHERE course_id = 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Award WHERE result = 'Nominee' AND person_id = (SELECT person_id FROM Person WHERE name = 'Rene Balcer')

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / 9 FROM Credit AS T1 INNER JOIN Episode AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.category = 'Cast' AND T1.credited = 'true' AND T2.number_in_series BETWEEN 185 AND 193
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN v.stars = 1 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(v.episode_id) AS percentage FROM Episode e JOIN Vote v ON e.episode_id = v.episode_id WHERE e.title = 'True North';
SELECT p.name FROM Person p JOIN Credit c ON p.person_id = c.person_id JOIN Episode e ON e.episode_id = c.episode_id WHERE c.role = 'stunt coordinator' AND e.episode = 3
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT episode_id) FROM Award WHERE result = 'Nominee'
SELECT c.role FROM Person p JOIN Credit c ON c.person_id = p.person_id WHERE p.height_meters = (SELECT MAX(height_meters) FROM Person)

SELECT CAST(SUM(v.stars) AS REAL) / COUNT(v.episode_id) AS avg_star_rating
FROM Person p
JOIN Credit c ON c.person_id = p.person_id
JOIN Vote v ON v.episode_id = c.episode_id
WHERE p.name = 'Jim Bracchitta';

SELECT DISTINCT p.name
FROM Award a JOIN Person p ON p.person_id = a.person_id
WHERE a.organization = 'American Bar Association Silver Gavel Awards for Media and the Arts'
  AND a.award_category = 'Silver Gavel Award'
  AND a.award = 'Television'
  AND a.result = 'Winner'
  AND a.role = 'writer'
  AND a.series = 'Law and Order'
GROUP BY p.person_id, p.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.year) >= 2;

SELECT e.title
FROM Episode e JOIN Vote v ON e.episode_id = v.episode_id
GROUP BY e.episode_id, e.title
ORDER BY SUM(v.stars * v.percent) / 100.0 DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT CAST(SUM(V.stars) AS REAL) / COUNT(V.episode_id) FROM Vote V JOIN Award A ON V.episode_id = A.episode_id WHERE A.result = 'Winner' AND V.percent = (SELECT MAX(V2.percent) FROM Vote V2 JOIN Award A2 ON V2.episode_id = A2.episode_id WHERE A2.result = 'Winner')
SELECT DISTINCT p.name FROM Person p JOIN Credit c ON p.person_id = c.person_id JOIN Award a ON a.episode_id = c.episode_id WHERE a.result = 'Winner' AND p.height_meters > 1.8
SELECT DISTINCT e.episode_id FROM Episode e JOIN Award a ON a.episode_id = e.episode_id WHERE e.rating = 8.5 AND a.award = 'Best Television Episode' AND a.result = 'Winner';

SELECT (SELECT o.VALUE FROM observations o JOIN patients p ON p.patient=o.PATIENT WHERE p.first='Elly' AND p.last='Koss' AND o.DESCRIPTION='Body Weight' AND o.DATE LIKE '2009%') - (SELECT o.VALUE FROM observations o JOIN patients p ON p.patient=o.PATIENT WHERE p.first='Elly' AND p.last='Koss' AND o.DESCRIPTION='Body Weight' AND o.DATE LIKE '2008%') AS weight_increase;

SELECT SUM(365*(strftime('%Y',T1.STOP)-strftime('%Y',T1.START)) + 30*(strftime('%m',T1.STOP)-strftime('%m',T1.START)) + (strftime('%d',T1.STOP)-strftime('%d',T1.START))) FROM medications T1 JOIN patients T2 ON T1.PATIENT=T2.patient WHERE T1.DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Acetaminophen%' AND T2.first='Elly' AND T2.last='Koss'
SELECT m.DESCRIPTION FROM medications m JOIN patients p ON p.patient = m.PATIENT WHERE p.first = 'Elly' AND p.last = 'Koss' AND m.REASONDESCRIPTION LIKE 'Streptococcal sore throat%';
SELECT ap."PREVALENCE RATE" FROM all_prevalences ap WHERE ap.ITEM = (SELECT DISTINCT DESCRIPTION FROM conditions WHERE CODE = 368581000119106);
SELECT pr.DESCRIPTION FROM procedures pr JOIN patients p ON pr.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Jacquelyn' AND p.last = 'Shanahan' AND pr.DATE = '2009-08-09'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims c JOIN patients p ON c.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.last = 'Cole' AND p.first LIKE 'Abbie%' AND c.BILLABLEPERIOD BETWEEN '2010-12-31' AND '2012-01-01'

SELECT SUM(JULIANDAY(T1.STOP) - JULIANDAY(T1.START)) * 1.0 / COUNT(T1.ID) AS avg_period FROM careplans AS T1 JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.first = 'Wesley' AND T2.last = 'Lemke' AND T2.prefix = 'Mr.'

SELECT SUM(JULIANDAY(c.STOP) - JULIANDAY(c.START)) / COUNT(c.DESCRIPTION = 'Normal pregnancy') FROM conditions c JOIN patients p ON c.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Angelena' AND p.last = 'Kertzmann' AND p.prefix = 'Ms.' AND c.DESCRIPTION = 'Normal pregnancy'

SELECT PATIENT FROM allergies WHERE STOP IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(STOP,-2,1) != '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(STOP,LENGTH(STOP)-1) AS INTEGER)+2000 ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(STOP,LENGTH(STOP)-1) AS INTEGER)+1900 END)
       - (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(START,-2,1) = '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(START,LENGTH(START)-1) AS INTEGER)+1900 ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(START,LENGTH(START)-1) AS INTEGER)+2000 END) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT FROM observations WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Body Height' AND VALUE = (SELECT MAX(VALUE) FROM observations WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Body Height')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM immunizations WHERE PATIENT = (SELECT c.PATIENT FROM conditions c JOIN all_prevalences p ON LOWER(c.DESCRIPTION) = LOWER(p.ITEM) ORDER BY p."PREVALENCE RATE" DESC, c.START DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.PATIENT) FROM conditions c WHERE LOWER(c.DESCRIPTION) = (SELECT LOWER(ITEM) FROM all_prevalences ORDER BY "PREVALENCE RATE" DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT PATIENT FROM careplans WHERE CODE = 311791003;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ssn
FROM patients p
JOIN conditions c ON c.PATIENT = p.patient
JOIN all_prevalences a ON a.ITEM = c.DESCRIPTION
WHERE a."PREVALENCE PERCENTAGE" < 0.3 * (SELECT AVG("PREVALENCE PERCENTAGE") FROM all_prevalences)
ORDER BY p.ssn;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1."gender" = 'F' AND T1."race" = 'asian' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1."patient") FROM "patients" AS T1 INNER JOIN "conditions" AS T2 ON T1."patient" = T2."PATIENT" WHERE T2."DESCRIPTION" = 'Acute bronchitis (disorder)'
SELECT a.START FROM allergies a JOIN patients p ON p.patient = a.PATIENT WHERE p.first = 'Angelo' AND p.last = 'Buckridge'

SELECT (SUM(p.deathdate) - SUM(p.birthdate)) / COUNT(p.patient) AS average_age
FROM patients p
WHERE p.patient IN (SELECT PATIENT FROM careplans WHERE REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Prediabetes')

SELECT p.first, p.last
FROM patients p JOIN allergies a ON a.PATIENT = p.patient
GROUP BY p.patient, p.first, p.last
HAVING COUNT(a.DESCRIPTION) > 3
ORDER BY p.last, p.first;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.PATIENT) FROM observations o JOIN careplans c ON o.PATIENT = c.PATIENT WHERE o.DESCRIPTION = 'Body Weight' AND o.VALUE > 100 AND o.UNITS = 'kg' AND c.DESCRIPTION = 'Diabetes self management plan'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient) FROM patients p JOIN medications m ON p.patient = m.PATIENT WHERE p.ethnicity = 'irish' AND m.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Myocardial Infarction'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.PATIENT) FROM careplans c JOIN immunizations i ON i.PATIENT = c.PATIENT WHERE c.STOP = '2013-11-23' AND i.DESCRIPTION = 'rotavirus  monovalent'

SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient) FROM patients p JOIN allergies a ON p.patient = a.PATIENT WHERE p.birthplace = 'Pembroke MA US' AND a.DESCRIPTION = 'Allergy to grass pollen') AS REAL) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients WHERE birthplace = 'Pembroke MA US')

SELECT a.STOP - a.START AS duration, a.DESCRIPTION
FROM allergies a
JOIN patients p ON a.PATIENT = p.patient
WHERE p.first = 'Isadora' AND p.last = 'Moen';

SELECT DISTINCT p.first, p.last
FROM careplans c JOIN patients p ON p.patient = c.PATIENT
WHERE p.marital = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', c.START) = '2009'
  AND julianday(c.STOP) - julianday(c.START) > 60
ORDER BY p.last, p.first;

SELECT DISTINCT i.DATE FROM immunizations i JOIN patients p ON i.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Elly' AND p.last = 'Koss' AND i.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' ORDER BY i.DATE

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.PATIENT) FROM immunizations i JOIN patients p ON p.patient = i.PATIENT WHERE i.DATE BETWEEN '2010-07-09' AND '2013-10-29' AND i.DESCRIPTION = 'meningococcal MCV4P' AND p.race = 'black'

SELECT i.CODE, i.DATE FROM immunizations i JOIN patients p ON i.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Jacquelyn' AND p.last = 'Shanahan' AND p.prefix = 'Ms.' AND i.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' ORDER BY i.DATE

SELECT JULIANDAY(T1.STOP) - JULIANDAY(T1.START) AS duration FROM medications AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.first = 'Berry' AND T2.last = 'Keebler' AND T1.DESCRIPTION = 'Acetaminophen 160 MG' AND T1.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Acute bronchitis (disorder)'
SELECT p.ssn, p.address FROM patients p JOIN encounters e ON e.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE e.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Viral sinusitis (disorder)' AND e.DATE = '2008-06-13';

SELECT m.REASONDESCRIPTION, m.DESCRIPTION, (julianday(m.STOP)-julianday(m.START)) AS duration, CASE WHEN p.deathdate IS NULL THEN 'alive' ELSE 'not alive' END AS alive_status FROM medications m JOIN encounters e ON m.ENCOUNTER=e.ID JOIN patients p ON m.PATIENT=p.patient WHERE e.ID='23c293ec-dbae-4a22-896e-f12cf3c8bac3';

SELECT p.first, p.last FROM patients p JOIN allergies a ON p.patient = a.PATIENT WHERE a.DESCRIPTION = 'Shellfish allergy' AND p.deathdate IS NOT NULL AND (julianday(p.deathdate) - julianday(p.birthdate)) / 365.0 < 12

SELECT julianday(m.STOP) - julianday(m.START) AS duration_days
FROM medications m
JOIN patients p ON p.patient = m.PATIENT
WHERE p.first = 'Major' AND p.last = 'D''Amore'
  AND m.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%Amoxicillin 250 MG / Clavulanate 125 MG [Augmentin]%';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.DESCRIPTION) FROM medications AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.first = 'Major' AND T2.last = 'D''Amore'

SELECT T1.DESCRIPTION FROM conditions AS T1 INNER JOIN observations AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Body Mass Index' AND T2.VALUE = (SELECT MIN(VALUE) FROM observations WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Body Mass Index') GROUP BY T1.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY COUNT(T1.DESCRIPTION) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT c.DESCRIPTION
FROM careplans c
JOIN patients p ON p.patient = c.PATIENT
WHERE p.prefix = 'Mrs.' AND p.first = 'Elly' AND p.last = 'Koss'
  AND substr(c.START, 1, 4) = '1970'
  AND substr(c.STOP, 1, 4) = '1970'

SELECT p.DESCRIPTION AS procedure, m.DESCRIPTION AS medicine
FROM procedures p
JOIN medications m ON m.PATIENT = p.PATIENT
WHERE p.PATIENT IN (SELECT PATIENT FROM encounters WHERE REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Drug overdose')

SELECT SUM(VALUE) / COUNT(PATIENT) AS avg_bmi
FROM observations
WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Body Mass Index'
  AND PATIENT IN (SELECT PATIENT FROM observations WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Total Cholesterol' AND VALUE >= 200);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.PATIENT) * 100.0 /
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PATIENT) FROM conditions WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Viral sinusitis (disorder)') AS percentage
FROM conditions c
JOIN patients p ON p.patient = c.PATIENT
WHERE c.DESCRIPTION = 'Viral sinusitis (disorder)'
  AND (julianday(c.START) - julianday(p.birthdate)) / 365.25 > 60;

SELECT T1.birthdate - T2.DATE FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN encounters AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.first = 'Stacy' AND T1.last = 'Morar' AND T2.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Drug overdose' ORDER BY T2.DATE ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(COUNT("PATIENT") AS REAL) / COUNT(SUBSTRING("DATE", 1, 4)) FROM "procedures" WHERE "DESCRIPTION" = 'Combined chemotherapy and radiation therapy (procedure)'
SELECT T1."START" - T1."STOP", T1."DESCRIPTION" FROM "allergies" AS T1 INNER JOIN "patients" AS T2 ON T1."PATIENT" = T2."patient" WHERE T2."first" = 'Isadora' AND T2."last" = 'Moen'

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS interactions, 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DESCRIPTION='Prenatal visit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(ID) AS pct FROM encounters WHERE PATIENT='007cbcc1-7333-4c79-b5e9-ffa93822fa11' AND substr(DATE,1,4) BETWEEN '2010' AND '2017';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.PATIENT) AS count FROM conditions c JOIN patients p ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND c.DESCRIPTION = 'Prediabetes';
SELECT DISTINCT c.PATIENT FROM conditions c JOIN all_prevalences a ON LOWER(c.DESCRIPTION) = LOWER(a.ITEM) WHERE a.OCCURRENCES = (SELECT MAX(OCCURRENCES) FROM all_prevalences)
SELECT a.DESCRIPTION FROM allergies a JOIN patients p ON p.patient = a.PATIENT WHERE p.first = 'Dirk' AND p.last = 'Langosh' AND p.ethnicity = 'dominican';

SELECT p.productName, (p.MSRP - p.buyPrice) AS expectedProfit, (od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalPrice
FROM products p
JOIN orderdetails od ON od.productCode = p.productCode
WHERE p.productCode IN ('S10_1949','S24_1937')
AND od.quantityOrdered = (SELECT MAX(quantityOrdered) FROM orderdetails WHERE productCode = p.productCode)
ORDER BY expectedProfit DESC;
SELECT T1.firstName || T1.lastName AS fullName FROM employees AS T1 INNER JOIN offices AS T2 ON T1.officeCode = T2.officeCode WHERE T2.city = 'Tokyo'

SELECT COUNT(T1.email), T1.email, T2.country
FROM employees AS T1
JOIN offices AS T2 ON T1.officeCode = T2.officeCode
JOIN customers AS T3 ON T1.employeeNumber = T3.salesRepEmployeeNumber
WHERE T2.country = 'Australia' AND T3.creditLimit < 20000
GROUP BY T1.email, T2.country

SELECT e.email FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode JOIN customers c ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber WHERE o.country = 'UK' AND e.jobTitle = 'Sales Rep' ORDER BY c.creditLimit ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS total_value
FROM orderdetails od
JOIN orders o ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber
JOIN products p ON p.productCode = od.productCode
WHERE o.status = 'Shipped'
  AND p.productLine = 'Vintage Cars'
  AND strftime('%Y', o.orderDate) BETWEEN '2003' AND '2004';
SELECT CAST(SUM(customerNumber = 186) AS REAL) / COUNT(orderNumber) AS percentage FROM orders WHERE status = 'Shipped' AND strftime('%Y', shippedDate) = '2005';

SELECT o.addressLine1, o.addressLine2 FROM offices o JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode GROUP BY o.officeCode HAVING COUNT(e.employeeNumber) = 4 AND SUM(CASE WHEN e.jobTitle LIKE 'Sales Rep%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
SELECT SUM(MSRP - buyPrice) AS profit FROM products WHERE productVendor = 'Carousel DieCast Legends' AND productLine = 'Ships';

SELECT c.customerName
FROM customers c
JOIN payments p ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber
WHERE c.city = 'Boston'
GROUP BY c.customerNumber, c.customerName
ORDER BY AVG(p.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(od.quantityOrdered) FROM orderdetails od WHERE od.productCode IN (SELECT productCode FROM products WHERE MSRP - buyPrice = (SELECT MAX(MSRP - buyPrice) FROM products));
SELECT m.firstName || ' ' || m.lastName AS fullName FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.reportsTo = m.employeeNumber WHERE e.firstName = 'Steve' AND e.lastName = 'Patterson';
SELECT e2.email FROM customers c JOIN employees e1 ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e1.employeeNumber JOIN employees e2 ON e1.reportsTo = e2.employeeNumber WHERE c.customerName = 'Muscle Machine Inc'
SELECT SUM(od.quantityOrdered * (od.priceEach - p.buyPrice)) AS profit FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode WHERE od.orderNumber = 10100;
SELECT COUNT(quantityOrdered) FROM orderdetails WHERE productCode IN (SELECT productCode FROM products WHERE productName = '2003 Harley-Davidson Eagle Drag Bike')
SELECT o.shippedDate FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber WHERE od.priceEach = (SELECT MAX(priceEach) FROM orderdetails)

SELECT c.customerName, od.quantityOrdered * (od.priceEach - p.buyPrice) AS profit
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber
JOIN orderdetails od ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber
JOIN products p ON p.productCode = od.productCode
ORDER BY profit DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2."customerName", SUM(T4."quantityOrdered") FROM "employees" AS T1 INNER JOIN "customers" AS T2 ON T1."employeeNumber" = T2."salesRepEmployeeNumber" INNER JOIN "orders" AS T3 ON T2."customerNumber" = T3."customerNumber" INNER JOIN "orderdetails" AS T4 ON T3."orderNumber" = T4."orderNumber" INNER JOIN "products" AS T5 ON T4."productCode" = T5."productCode" WHERE T5."productName" = '1969 Harley Davidson Ultimate Chopper' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T3."orderDate") = '2003' GROUP BY T2."customerName"
SELECT CAST(COUNT(m.name) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM male) AS percentage FROM male m JOIN enlist e ON m.name = e.name WHERE e.organ = 'navy'
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM disabled WHERE name='student281') THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS disabled, (SELECT school FROM enrolled WHERE name='student281') AS school
SELECT f."name" FROM "filed_for_bankrupcy" AS f INNER JOIN "enlist" AS e ON f."name" = e."name" WHERE e."organ" = 'foreign_legion'
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enlist WHERE organ = 'navy') FROM enlist AS e INNER JOIN enrolled AS en ON e.name = en.name WHERE e.organ = 'navy' AND en.school = 'occ'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM unemployed u JOIN filed_for_bankrupcy f ON u.name = f.name JOIN no_payment_due n ON u.name = n.name WHERE n.bool = 'pos'
SELECT p.name FROM person p JOIN disabled d ON p.name = d.name JOIN male m ON p.name = m.name WHERE p.name = 'student124'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enlist e WHERE e.organ IN ('marines','air_force') AND e.name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male) AND name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM enlist)
SELECT organ FROM enlist WHERE name = 'student313'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2."name") FROM "enlist" AS T2 WHERE T2."organ" = 'air_force' AND T2."name" NOT IN (SELECT "name" FROM "male")

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3."month" > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T3."month") FROM "unemployed" AS T1 INNER JOIN "person" AS T2 ON T1."name" = T2."name" INNER JOIN "longest_absense_from_school" AS T3 ON T2."name" = T3."name"
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM male WHERE name = 'student1000') THEN 'male' ELSE 'female' END AS gender;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enlist WHERE organ IN ('foreign_legion','peace_corps','army')
SELECT p.name FROM person p JOIN longest_absense_from_school l ON p.name = l.name WHERE l.month = 0 AND p.name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male) ORDER BY p.name;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT e.name FROM enlist e JOIN male m ON m.name = e.name GROUP BY e.name HAVING COUNT(e.organ) > 1);
SELECT d.name FROM disabled d WHERE d.name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male) ORDER BY d.name;
SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(name) FROM unemployed) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(name) FROM disabled) AS ratio;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disabled) AS avg
FROM disabled
WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male)
  AND name IN (SELECT name FROM enlist WHERE organ = 'foreign_legion');

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enlist WHERE organ='fire_department' AND name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male)) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enlist WHERE organ='fire_department') || '%' AS FEMALE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enlist WHERE organ='fire_department' AND name IN (SELECT name FROM male)) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enlist WHERE organ='fire_department') || '%' AS MALE;
SELECT (CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disabled) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM disabled))) || '%' AS percentage;
SELECT name FROM enlist WHERE organ = 'air_force' AND name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male) LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM disabled)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM male WHERE name='student995') THEN 'male' ELSE 'female' END AS gender, school FROM enrolled WHERE name='student995'

SELECT e.organ, SUM(CASE WHEN m.name IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male, SUM(CASE WHEN m.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female FROM enlist e LEFT JOIN male m ON m.name = e.name GROUP BY e.organ ORDER BY e.organ
SELECT e.school, COUNT(f.name) AS bankrupt_count FROM enrolled e LEFT JOIN filed_for_bankrupcy f ON f.name = e.name GROUP BY e.school ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM enlist WHERE organ = 'marines' AND name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male);
SELECT name FROM filed_for_bankrupcy WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male);
SELECT (CAST(COUNT(male.name) AS REAL) / COUNT(person.name)) * 100 AS percentage FROM person LEFT JOIN male ON person.name = male.name;
SELECT e.school, CASE WHEN m.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'male' ELSE 'female' END AS gender FROM enrolled e LEFT JOIN male m ON m.name = e.name WHERE e.name = 'student34';
SELECT organ FROM enlist GROUP BY organ ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM enlist e WHERE e.organ = 'army' AND e.name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM male);
SELECT e.organ FROM enlist e JOIN male m ON e.name = m.name GROUP BY e.organ ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disabled AS d JOIN longest_absense_from_school AS l ON d.name = l.name WHERE l.month = 0 AND d.name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM unemployed)

SELECT e.organ, 1.0*COUNT(m.name)/COUNT(p.name) AS pct
FROM enlist e
JOIN person p ON p.name=e.name
LEFT JOIN male m ON m.name=e.name
GROUP BY e.organ
ORDER BY COUNT(m.name) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT "nameGiven" FROM "Master" WHERE "pos" = 'F' AND "shootCatch" IS NULL

SELECT nameGiven, birthYear, birthMon, birthDay
FROM Master
WHERE deathYear IS NULL
ORDER BY CAST(birthYear AS INTEGER) DESC, CAST(birthMon AS INTEGER) DESC, CAST(birthDay AS INTEGER) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT m.lastName, g.year
FROM Master m
JOIN Goalies g ON m.playerID = g.playerID
WHERE m.deathYear IS NOT NULL
  AND g.Min = (SELECT MAX(g2.Min) FROM Goalies g2 WHERE g2.playerID = m.playerID)
ORDER BY m.lastName

SELECT m.nameGiven, m.height, m.weight, CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(m.birthYear AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Goalies g JOIN Master m ON g.playerID = m.playerID
WHERE g.tmID = 'COL' AND g.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
ORDER BY g.year, g.playerID, g.stint
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE CAST(T2.ENG AS INTEGER) >= 10
SELECT T1."firstName", T1."lastName", T2."year" FROM "Master" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Goalies" AS T2 ON T1."playerID" = T2."playerID" ORDER BY T2."GA" / T2."SA" ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.firstName || ' ' || m.lastName AS name, g.year
FROM Goalies g JOIN Master m ON m.playerID = g.playerID
WHERE g.GA IS NOT NULL AND CAST(g.GA AS INTEGER) <> 0 AND g.SHO IS NOT NULL
  AND (CAST(g.SHO AS REAL) / CAST(g.GA AS REAL)) * 100 = 5.00
ORDER BY g.year, name;

SELECT firstName || ' ' || lastName AS name, birthYear FROM Master WHERE deathYear IS NOT NULL AND deathCountry IS NOT NULL AND birthCountry IS NOT NULL AND deathCountry != birthCountry ORDER BY CAST(birthYear AS INTEGER);
SELECT nameGiven, pos FROM Master WHERE deathYear IS NULL AND pos LIKE '%/%' ORDER BY nameGiven

SELECT DISTINCT m.firstName || ' ' || m.lastName AS goalie, t.name AS team
FROM Master m
JOIN Goalies g ON g.playerID = m.playerID
JOIN Teams t ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmID = g.tmID
WHERE m.pos = 'G' AND m.shootCatch = 'L' AND m.coachID IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY goalie, team;

SELECT DISTINCT m.firstName || ' ' || m.lastName AS name, g.year
FROM Teams t
JOIN Goalies g ON g.year = t.year AND g.tmID = t.tmID
JOIN Master m ON m.playerID = g.playerID
WHERE t.name = 'Boston Bruins' AND t.rank = 1
ORDER BY g.year, name

SELECT m.firstName, c.tmID
FROM Coaches c
JOIN Master m ON m.coachID = c.coachID
WHERE m.playerID IS NULL AND c.g > 0
ORDER BY (CAST(c.w AS REAL)/c.g)*100 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT m.firstName || ' ' || m.lastName AS coach, c.year, (CAST(c.w AS REAL)/c.g)*100 AS win_pct
FROM Coaches c
JOIN Master m ON m.coachID = c.coachID
WHERE c.tmID = 'DET'
ORDER BY win_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT m.firstName,
       m.birthDay || m.birthMon || m.birthYear AS dob,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tmID) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tmID FROM Coaches WHERE coachID='irvindi01c' AND year < 1940 ORDER BY year)) AS teams
FROM Master m WHERE m.coachID='irvindi01c';

SELECT m.firstName, m.lastName, g.tmID
FROM Goalies g
JOIN Master m ON m.playerID = g.playerID
WHERE g.L > g.W
GROUP BY g.playerID, g.tmID
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY m.lastName, m.firstName, g.tmID
SELECT G.year, CAST(G.W AS REAL)/CAST(G.GP AS REAL)*100 AS pct FROM Master M JOIN Goalies G ON M.playerID=G.playerID WHERE M.birthYear='1987' AND M.shootCatch IS NULL ORDER BY G.year

SELECT m.lastName, m.firstName
FROM Goalies g JOIN Master m ON m.playerID=g.playerID
WHERE m.deathYear IS NULL
GROUP BY g.playerID
HAVING SUM(CAST(g.W AS REAL))/SUM(CAST(g.GP AS REAL))*100 > 50
ORDER BY m.lastName, m.firstName
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Goalies WHERE PostW = PostL
SELECT HOF.year FROM Master JOIN HOF ON Master.hofID = HOF.hofID WHERE CAST(Master.height AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(CAST(height AS INTEGER)) FROM Master)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ac.coachID) AS n
FROM AwardsCoaches ac
JOIN Master m ON m.coachID = ac.coachID
WHERE ac.year > 1940 AND m.deathYear IS NOT NULL;
SELECT DISTINCT ap.award FROM AwardsPlayers ap JOIN Master m ON m.playerID = ap.playerID WHERE m.deathCity = 'Arlington' ORDER BY ap.award
SELECT COUNT(T1.hofID) FROM HOF AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.hofID = T2.hofID WHERE T2.birthMon IN ('7','8')
SELECT DISTINCT T2."pos" FROM "Master" AS T1 INNER JOIN "AwardsPlayers" AS T2 ON T1."playerID" = T2."playerID" WHERE T1."birthCountry" = 'Canada' AND T2."award" = 'All-Rookie' ORDER BY T2."pos"
SELECT SUM(CAST(m.weight AS REAL) / (CAST(m.height AS REAL) * CAST(m.height AS REAL))) / COUNT(m.coachID) AS avg_bmi FROM Master m WHERE m.coachID IS NOT NULL AND m.hofID IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(m.hofID)*100.0/COUNT(h.hofID) AS pct FROM HOF h LEFT JOIN Master m ON h.hofID=m.hofID AND m.birthCountry='USA';
SELECT CASE WHEN am.note = 'posthumous' THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END AS attended FROM Master m JOIN AwardsMisc am ON am.ID = m.hofID WHERE m.legendsID = 'P194502'

SELECT T.Pts
FROM Teams T
WHERE T.year = 1995
  AND T.tmID = (
    SELECT G.tmID FROM Goalies G
    WHERE G.year = 1995
    GROUP BY G.tmID
    ORDER BY SUM(CAST(G.PostSHO AS INTEGER)) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  );
SELECT T1."coachID", T2."nameNick" FROM "Coaches" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Master" AS T2 ON T1."coachID" = T2."coachID" WHERE T1."year" = 2009 ORDER BY CAST(T1."w" AS REAL) / (T1."w" + T1."l") DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.firstName, m.lastName FROM Coaches c JOIN Master m ON m.coachID = c.coachID JOIN Teams t ON t.year = c.year AND t.tmID = c.tmID WHERE c.year = 2011 AND c.tmID = (SELECT tmID FROM Teams WHERE year = 2011 ORDER BY CAST(PPG AS REAL)/CAST(PPC AS REAL) DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT COUNT(year) FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'cleghsp01'
SELECT lgID FROM Scoring WHERE playerID = 'adamsja01' AND year = 1920

SELECT T1."W" FROM "Teams" AS T1 WHERE T1."year" = 2011 AND T1."tmID" = (SELECT T2."tmID" FROM "Goalies" AS T2 WHERE T2."year" = 2011 AND T2."PostGP" IS NOT NULL AND T2."PostGP" <> '0' GROUP BY T2."tmID" HAVING COUNT(*) = 3)
SELECT T1."birthYear" FROM "Master" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Goalies" AS T2 ON T1."playerID" = T2."playerID" WHERE T2."year" = 2008 ORDER BY CAST(T2."PostSA" AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(c.year - CAST(m.lastNHL AS INTEGER)) FROM Master m JOIN Coaches c ON m.coachID = c.coachID WHERE m.firstName = 'Don' AND m.lastName = 'Waddell'
SELECT T1.birthYear, T1.birthMon, T1.birthDay FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 1965 ORDER BY CAST(T2.GA AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master T1 JOIN Scoring T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T2.year=1981 ORDER BY CAST(T2."+/-" AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Scoring AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 1986 ORDER BY CAST(T2.GWG AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.firstName, m.lastName FROM Coaches c JOIN Master m ON m.coachID = c.coachID WHERE c.year = 2003 AND c.tmID = (SELECT tmID FROM Teams WHERE year = 2003 ORDER BY CAST(BenchMinor AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT T1.playerID FROM Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE CAST(T2.weight AS INTEGER) > 190 AND T1.year = 1978 ORDER BY CAST(T1.GA AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (CAST(c06.w AS REAL)/(c06.w + c06.l)) - (CAST(c05.w AS REAL)/(c05.w + c05.l)) AS improvement
FROM Coaches c06, Coaches c05
WHERE c06.tmID = 'VAN' AND c06.year = 2006 AND c06.coachID = 'vigneal01c'
  AND c05.tmID = 'VAN' AND c05.year = 2005;

SELECT m.legendsID FROM Goalies g JOIN Master m ON m.playerID = g.playerID WHERE g.year = 2011 AND g.PostSA IS NOT NULL AND CAST(g.PostSA AS REAL) > 0 AND g.PostGA IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (1.0 - CAST(g.PostGA AS REAL) / CAST(g.PostSA AS REAL)) * 100 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT award FROM AwardsCoaches WHERE coachID = (SELECT coachID FROM Coaches GROUP BY coachID ORDER BY SUM(w) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY award ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(COUNT(hofID) AS REAL) / 30 FROM HOF WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1980
SELECT T.W FROM Teams T JOIN Goalies G ON T.year = G.year AND T.tmID = G.tmID WHERE CAST(G.SHO AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(CAST(SHO AS INTEGER)) FROM Goalies)

SELECT pos FROM Master
WHERE playerID IS NOT NULL AND birthYear IS NOT NULL AND birthYear <> ''
ORDER BY CAST(birthYear AS INTEGER), CAST(birthMon AS INTEGER), CAST(birthDay AS INTEGER)
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 8;
SELECT "PostGA" FROM "Goalies" WHERE "lgID" = 'WCHL' AND "year" = 1924 ORDER BY CAST("PostGA" AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT tmID, OctL FROM TeamSplits WHERE year = 2006 ORDER BY CAST(OctL AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT s.year, s.year - CAST(m.birthYear AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Scoring s JOIN Master m ON s.playerID = m.playerID ORDER BY s.G DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT AVG(CAST(height AS REAL)) FROM Master WHERE pos='G' AND birthYear BETWEEN '1970' AND '1979' AND shootCatch='L') AS avg_height, (SELECT t.name FROM Goalies g JOIN Teams t ON t.year=g.year AND t.tmID=g.tmID WHERE g.playerID IN (SELECT playerID FROM Master WHERE pos='G' AND birthYear BETWEEN '1970' AND '1979' AND shootCatch='L' AND CAST(height AS INTEGER)=(SELECT MAX(CAST(height AS INTEGER)) FROM Master WHERE pos='G' AND birthYear BETWEEN '1970' AND '1979' AND shootCatch='L')) ORDER BY g.year DESC LIMIT 1) AS team

SELECT CAST(t.PPG AS REAL) / CAST(t.PPC AS REAL) AS pp_pct,
       CASE WHEN t.tmID = s.tmIDWinner THEN s.tmIDLoser ELSE s.tmIDWinner END AS opponent,
       CASE WHEN t.tmID = s.tmIDWinner THEN 'victorious' ELSE 'lost' END AS result
FROM Teams t
JOIN SeriesPost s ON t.year = s.year AND (t.tmID = s.tmIDWinner OR t.tmID = s.tmIDLoser)
WHERE t.PKC IS NOT NULL AND t.PKC <> ''
ORDER BY CAST(t.PKC AS REAL) ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T1."name" FROM "Teams" AS T1 INNER JOIN "SeriesPost" AS T2 ON T1."tmID" = T2."tmIDLoser" AND T1."year" = T2."year" WHERE T2."note" = 'EX' AND T2."year" = 1912

SELECT (s.year - CAST(m.firstNHL AS INTEGER)) AS duration, m.nameGiven || ' ' || m.lastName AS fullname
FROM Scoring s JOIN Master m ON m.playerID=s.playerID
WHERE s.lgID='NHL' AND s."+/-" IS NOT NULL AND m.firstNHL IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(s."+/-" AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(g) FROM Coaches WHERE coachID = (SELECT coachID FROM AwardsCoaches WHERE award='Second Team All-Star' ORDER BY year LIMIT 1) AND year < (SELECT MIN(year) FROM AwardsCoaches WHERE award='Second Team All-Star');
SELECT coachID, l FROM Coaches WHERE year = 1997 AND tmID = 'TBL' AND notes = 'interim';
SELECT c.coachID FROM Coaches c JOIN Teams t ON c.year = t.year AND c.tmID = t.tmID WHERE t.year = 1969 AND t.rank = 4
SELECT T1.name FROM Teams T1 JOIN TeamsHalf T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.half = 1 AND T2.year BETWEEN 1917 AND 1920 AND T2.rank = 1 ORDER BY T2.year

SELECT m.nameGiven || ' ' || m.lastName AS name, s.year, s.tmID
FROM Master m JOIN Scoring s ON m.playerID = s.playerID
WHERE m.birthCountry = 'Canada'
  AND CAST(m.firstNHL AS INTEGER) - CAST(m.birthYear AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 18 AND 24
  AND s.G < 5
SELECT CAST(PPG AS REAL) / CAST(PPC AS REAL) FROM Teams WHERE name = 'New York Rangers' AND year = 2009
SELECT name FROM Teams WHERE year = 2006 ORDER BY CAST(BenchMinor AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT t.name FROM SeriesPost s JOIN Teams t ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmID = s.tmIDWinner WHERE s.year = 1917 AND s.round = 'SCF' AND s.W > s.L;

SELECT COUNT(t.tmID) FROM Teams t WHERE t.year=1922 AND t.Pts>20 AND t.tmID IN (SELECT tmIDWinner FROM SeriesPost WHERE year=1922 AND round='SCF' UNION SELECT tmIDLoser FROM SeriesPost WHERE year=1922 AND round='SCF');
SELECT t.name, SUM(s.W) AS wins FROM SeriesPost s JOIN Teams t ON t.year = s.year AND t.tmID = s.tmIDWinner WHERE s.round = 'SCF' GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT name FROM Teams WHERE year = 1909 AND T > 0;
SELECT DISTINCT m.firstName FROM Coaches c JOIN Master m ON m.coachID=c.coachID WHERE c.year=1922 AND c.tmID IN ('OTS','EDE');

SELECT DISTINCT T1.nameNick FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T2.year = T3.year AND T2.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T3.name = 'Buffalo Sabres' AND T1.birthCountry = 'USA' AND T1.coachID IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT t.name FROM CombinedShutouts c JOIN Teams t ON t.tmID = c.tmID WHERE c.oppID IN (SELECT tmID FROM Teams WHERE name = 'Buffalo Sabres')
SELECT year FROM Scoring WHERE PIM = 49 AND year IN (1918, 1923, 1924);
SELECT CAST(W AS REAL)/G AS rate FROM Teams WHERE year=2000 AND name='Buffalo Sabres';
SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.PIM) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.G) FROM TeamsSC AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T2.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'
SELECT name FROM HOF WHERE LOWER(category) NOT IN ('player','builder') ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Master WHERE playerID IS NOT NULL AND coachID IS NOT NULL AND hofID IS NOT NULL
SELECT CAST(t.BenchMinor AS INTEGER) AS BenchMinor FROM Coaches c JOIN Teams t ON t.year=c.year AND t.tmID=c.tmID WHERE c.year=1982 AND c.coachID='bowmasc01c';
SELECT m.firstName || ' ' || m.lastName AS fullName FROM Goalies g JOIN Master m ON m.playerID = g.playerID WHERE g.tmID IN ('QU1','QUB') AND m.pos = 'G' ORDER BY CAST(g.Min AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT g.playerID) FROM Goalies g JOIN Master m ON g.playerID = m.playerID WHERE g.tmID = 'HAI' AND m.hofID IS NOT NULL
SELECT SUM(s.G) AS total_goals, (SELECT MAX(year) FROM Scoring) - CAST(m.birthYear AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Scoring s JOIN Master m ON s.playerID = m.playerID WHERE m.playerID = 'aaltoan01'
SELECT G FROM Teams WHERE year = 1976 AND tmID = 'BIR' AND divID = 'EW';
SELECT t.L AS losses, s.total_assists FROM Teams t, (SELECT SUM(A) AS total_assists FROM Scoring WHERE year=2010 AND tmID='BOS') s WHERE t.year=2010 AND t.tmID='BOS';
SELECT SUM(T1."weight") FROM "Master" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Scoring" AS T2 ON T1."playerID" = T2."playerID" WHERE T2."tmID" = 'ANA' AND T2."year" = 1997

SELECT DISTINCT s.tmID, m.birthCountry FROM Scoring s JOIN Master m ON m.playerID = s.playerID WHERE s.year = 2000 AND s.tmID = (SELECT tmID FROM Teams WHERE year = 2000 ORDER BY CAST(W AS REAL)/(W+L) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY m.birthCountry
SELECT student_staff_ratio FROM university_year ORDER BY student_staff_ratio DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT u.university_name
FROM university_ranking_year ury
JOIN ranking_criteria rc ON rc.id = ury.ranking_criteria_id
JOIN university u ON u.id = ury.university_id
WHERE ury.year = 2014 AND rc.criteria_name = 'Publications Rank'
ORDER BY ury.score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.university_name
FROM university u
JOIN country c ON u.country_id = c.id
JOIN university_ranking_year ury ON ury.university_id = u.id
JOIN ranking_criteria rc ON ury.ranking_criteria_id = rc.id
WHERE ury.year = 2016
  AND c.country_name = 'Australia'
  AND rc.criteria_name = 'Citations'
ORDER BY ury.score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN c.country_name = 'United States of America' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM university u JOIN country c ON u.country_id = c.id JOIN university_year uy ON u.id = uy.university_id WHERE uy.year = 2016 AND (uy.pct_female_students * uy.num_students) / 100.0 > 20000

SELECT T1.university_name FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN university_year AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.university_id GROUP BY T1.university_name ORDER BY MAX(T2.num_students * T2.pct_international_students / 100.0) DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT pct_international_students * num_students / 100, num_students FROM university_year WHERE university_id = 20 AND year = 2013
SELECT uy.num_students FROM university_year AS uy JOIN university_ranking_year AS ury ON ury.university_id = uy.university_id WHERE ury.score = 98 AND ury.year = 2013 AND uy.year = 2013
SELECT SUM(num_students * pct_female_students / 100) FROM university_year WHERE year = 2011
SELECT student_staff_ratio FROM university_year ORDER BY student_staff_ratio DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.pct_female_students * T1.num_students / 100.0 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T1.year = 2011 AND T2.university_name = 'Stanford University'

SELECT CAST(T1.pct_female_students * T1.num_students AS REAL) / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T2.university_name = 'Arizona State University' AND T1.year = 2014

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university) AS percentage, (SELECT u.university_name FROM university_ranking_year ury JOIN ranking_criteria rc ON ury.ranking_criteria_id = rc.id JOIN university u ON ury.university_id = u.id WHERE rc.criteria_name = 'International' AND ury.year = 2016 AND ury.score > 80 ORDER BY ury.score DESC LIMIT 1) AS university_name FROM university_ranking_year ury JOIN ranking_criteria rc ON ury.ranking_criteria_id = rc.id WHERE rc.criteria_name = 'International' AND ury.year = 2016 AND ury.score > 80

SELECT (T1.pct_female_students * T1.num_students) / 100.0 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T2.university_name = 'Pierre and Marie Curie University' AND T1.year = 2015

SELECT (T1.num_students * T1.pct_international_students) / 100.0 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T2.university_name = 'University of Wisconsin-Madison' AND T1.year = 2013

SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.id) AS REAL) / 3 FROM ranking_criteria AS T1 INNER JOIN ranking_system AS T2 ON T1.ranking_system_id = T2.id WHERE T2.system_name IN ('Times Higher Education World University Ranking', 'Shanghai Ranking', 'Center for World University Rankings')
SELECT SUM(pct_female_students * num_students / 100.0) FROM university_year WHERE university_id = 40 AND year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2013

SELECT CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_female_students AS REAL) / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T1.year = 2011 AND T2.university_name = 'University of Pennsylvania'

SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.num_students * T1.pct_female_students / 100.0) AS REAL) / SUM(T1.num_students) FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id INNER JOIN country AS T3 ON T2.country_id = T3.id WHERE T3.country_name = 'United States of America' AND T1.year = 2016

SELECT SUM(T1.num_students) - SUM(T1.num_students * T1.pct_international_students / 100.0) FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T2.university_name = 'University of Tokyo' AND T1.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2014

SELECT DISTINCT p.first, p.last
FROM patients p
JOIN encounters e ON p.patient = e.PATIENT
JOIN conditions c ON c.ENCOUNTER = e.ID
WHERE e.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Drug overdose'
AND ROUND((julianday(c.START) - julianday(p.birthdate))/365) = 44

SELECT DISTINCT p.first, p.last
FROM patients p
JOIN conditions c ON c.PATIENT = p.patient
JOIN all_prevalences a ON a.ITEM = c.DESCRIPTION
WHERE p.ethnicity = 'irish'
  AND a.OCCURRENCES > (SELECT AVG(OCCURRENCES * 0.96) FROM all_prevalences)
ORDER BY p.first, p.last;

SELECT p.productVendor, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * (p.MSRP - p.buyPrice)) AS total_estimated_earnings
FROM orderdetails od
JOIN products p ON p.productCode = od.productCode
GROUP BY p.productVendor
ORDER BY SUM(od.quantityOrdered) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName
FROM payments p
JOIN customers c ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber
JOIN employees e ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.paymentDate) = '2004'
ORDER BY p.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) FROM orderdetails od JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE c.customerName = 'Mini Gifts Distributors Ltd.' AND o.shippedDate BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2003-12-31'
SELECT T1.employeeNumber FROM employees AS T1 INNER JOIN offices AS T2 ON T1.officeCode = T2.officeCode WHERE T1.reportsTo = 1143 AND T2.city = 'NYC'
SELECT SUM(amount)/3.0, MAX(amount), MIN(amount) FROM payments WHERE paymentDate BETWEEN '2003-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
